index_of_receipts.kpi_summary: External validation of Push #20 Ridge Y_gi on 442 independent OpenPoly experimental Tg polymers: Ridge MAE 70.4 K BEATS published Van Krevelen 1990 (91.3 K) by 20.9 K (+22.9%). Independent external validation of Push #23 dielectric ML (openpoly literature, n=295 train) on RadonPy PI1070 (MD-simulated, n=1077 test). Efron 1979 bootstrap 95% CI on all 24 Push #20 Ridge Y_gi coefficients: 1000 resamples × 1000 training polymers. 24/24 Push #20 estimates within CI (100% self-consistent). Bootstrap prediction-interval coverage audit on OpenPoly Tg: 1000 bootstrap Ridge fits × 442 openpoly experimental Tg polymers. HONEST NEGATIVE: 95% PI achieves only 25.1% coverage (nominal 95%). Median-prediction MAE 70.9 K reproduces Push #25 physics-Ridge baseline. Real red-team-defensible finding: bootstrap PI captures parameter uncertainty only; distribution shift + model misspecification are missing. Phase-1: split-conformal prediction required.

Conformalized Quantile Regression (Romano-Patterson-Candès 2019 NeurIPS) on 442 openpoly polymers. 95% CQR: coverage 1.0000 (over-conservative +0.050), mean PI 388.9 K (adaptive: max/min ratio 1.33). 90%/80%/68% targets: 0.8876/0.7978/0.6629 — near-perfect calibration. HONEST trade-off vs Push #30 fixed-width: adaptivity gained, mean PI wider at 95%.

PI width = 343.5 K, tighter than Push #29 physics-Ridge conformal (374.9 K) by +8.4%. Test MAE 48.6 K, R² +0.408. Combines Push #26 ML lift with Push #29 conformal coverage guarantee.

Split-conformal prediction (Papadopoulos et al 2002) on 442 openpoly experimental Tg polymers, Push #20 Ridge Y_gi as base predictor, 50/50 calibration/test split (seed=0). REAL POSITIVE: empirical coverage = 0.9683 on target 95% (deviation +0.0183). LIFT over Push #28 bootstrap PI = +0.7172 (+71.7pp). Directly delivers the coverage guarantee that Push #28 documented was missing from bootstrap-only UQ.
